text:
⚡️🇺🇸 — U.S President Trump: 

"And I say, you know, it's really unfair. I don't get treated—CNN did a poll, 99% approval rating in the Republican Party. Ninety-nine! And we're looking for the 1% we think was a rigged poll.
​
And I'm at 90-something. No, but others do polls, I'm way up in, I'm the highest ever, higher than anybody, higher than Reagan. And they say, 'Well, he's—he's not currying,' you know, they like to say, 'He's not currying favor.
​
Everybody knows, we had to attack Iran, we had to make sure they never have a nuclear weapon, everybody knows. And it's going to be over very, very soon.
​
He's not currying. He's not currying, you know, to use this bullshit—yeah, so, fill it up."
